verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing describes a Notion-like editor with many formatting options and custom components for docs, which covers help content. Nothing in the pack says the same editor is used to author changelog entries; the changelog items cover only distribution (widgets, standalone page, email). missing for 10: evidence that the rich editor and custom components apply to changelog posts, a detailed list of the custom components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can use a rich text editor with custom components to format changelog and help content

citations.quote: Notion-like editor experience with tons of formatting options and custom components to make your docs stand out.
Scale your help content to global audiences in different brands, and 40+ languages.
